description: Synthetic inputs on which an earlier version of the NumPy port (NumPy/LAPACK svd/pinv/det/hypot/matmul instead of dlib's own scalar arithmetic) disagreed with live dlib-bin 20.0.1. Each case is regenerated by shape_predictor_evidence.synthetic_case(seed, index); the validator and CI test require exact landmark and chip agreement on every one.
